description.en: Returns the name of the motion an object is playing (as set with CMND_SET_MOTION). The NPC talk script saves it before the talk to restore it afterwards.

The motion name.
null if the object is not found or has no motion, the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Saving an NPC's motion before a talk (real usage, from ev43010000.nut)
